subject: Polaris Analytics — Dedicated capacity demo & throughput check
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam@polarisanalytics.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Demo request — dedicated pool for inference

Hi Karthik,

We signed up via your self-serve flow this morning and want to follow up about a Dedicated deployment for our production workload. High level: we expect sustained routing at ~1,200 QPS during peak windows (30–45 minute peaks) and a P95 token latency target of ~50ms. We're evaluating options because our current infra can't meet consistent P95s at scale.

Would like to book a short technical demo to see Dedicated capacity, redundancy/failover, and how batching/caching would impact our costs. Also important: quantization/FP settings you recommend for Gen-style LLMs and whether Redwood supports canary rollouts into our reserved pool.

I've attached a small sample of our request traces (anonymized) and a CSV with QPS buckets — should help you size.

Attachments: polaris_qps_samples.csv (csv, 42KB)

Would Tuesday or Wednesday next week work for a 30-min slot? Timezone: ET.

Thanks,
Liam O'Neill
Head of Platform
Polaris Analytics

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam@polarisanalytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 13:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — dedicated pool for inference

Hi Liam — thanks for the details and the trace CSV, super helpful. Happy to run through Dedicated and a sizing walkthrough.

Quick proposed agenda (30m):
- 5m: goals & current pain points (you)
- 10m: Dedicated topology, routing, fallback policies (me)
- 10m: Marissa runs through perf/throughput validation plan + Q/A
- 5m: next steps / trial plan / timeline

To size things pre-demo could you confirm:
- Typical avg sequence length and peak sequence length (tokens)
- Fraction of requests that are chat-like (stateful with KV cache) vs stateless single-shot generation
- Any expected burst above the 1,200 QPS you mentioned (e.g., 2x headroom)?

Marissa will join from Solutions to sketch a short validation we can run during the POC. I've attached a short worksheet with examples of what helps us size a Dedicated pool — can you drop your sample payloads there prior to the call? Link + Calendly below.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/karthik-30m
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/s/polaris-demo-worksheet
Attachment: redwood-demo-worksheet.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

Proposed slots (ET):
- Thurs 24 Jun, 11:00–11:30
- Fri 25 Jun, 09:30–10:00
- Mon 28 Jun, 14:00–14:30

If none of the above work send preferred times and we'll accommodate.

Thanks — look forward to it.

— Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 14:10:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — dedicated pool for inference

Karthik — I'll join. Quick note on what I'd like to validate during the call so we can get to a meaningful sizing:
- Run 2 short synthetic runs that mirror the distribution in polaris_qps_samples.csv (5–10 minutes each) to validate P95 at target QPS
- Request example prompt set (20–30 samples) representative of steady-state and peak flows
- Confirm tokenization and avg tokens/request to verify KV cache effectiveness for chat flows

If they can give us one representative payload set and an anonymized trace for the 30m call we'll be able to sketch a preliminary Dedicated pool (GPU count, memory profile, batching config) live.

Operational ask: recommend we propose a canary of 20–30% traffic into Dedicated for the first 48 hours and observe latency + error rates; fallback policy to hosted variants if errors spike.

I'll prepare a quick perf-check notebook and keep it light.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Neill <liam@polarisanalytics.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: ops@polarisanalytics.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 08:23:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — dedicated pool for inference

Thanks — heads up: we have a mandatory all-hands that conflicts with the 11:00 slot on Thu and several stakeholders (ops + infra) are only available early morning ET. Could we move to Fri 25 Jun at 09:30 ET? That works best for me and our infra lead.

I'll upload an anonymized trace and 25 sample prompts to the Drive link you sent. Also re-attaching the CSV in case it helps in the meantime.

Attachments: polaris_qps_samples.csv (csv, 42KB)

Best,
Liam

Great — Fri 25 Jun 09:30 ET is locked. I've updated the Calendly slot and added a note to run the small perf checks during the call; Marissa will run the notebook if they can share the trace + prompt set ahead of time.

Call: Fri 25 Jun 2027 09:30–10:00 ET (30m) — invite sent
Pre-demo asks (one-liners):
- Upload anonymized trace CSV and 25 prompts to Drive link
- Confirm avg tokens/request and peak sequence length
- Any compliance/security docs you want us to pre-read (SOC2 / data handling notes)

If you need a different timezone we can also move earlier on Fri — let me know. Looking forward to it.
